name: HMScan
summary:
HMScan turns the things around you into 3D assets for your games.

Put on your headset, place a box around an object and walk around it. A dome of squares fills with your photos as you go, so you always know what is left. When you finish, HMScan builds your model on the headset.

- Guided capture, made for first-time scanners
- Stereo Fusion and AI Processing build your model
- Gaussian splats for the most lifelike look
- Clean-up tools: remove the base, fill holes, make it solid, smooth it, wrap the textur
